FICTIONAL TEST DOCUMENT - NOT AN OFFICIAL PROCUREMENT RECORD
NORTH DELTA MUNICIPAL WORKS UNIT (FICTIONAL)
File: ND/MW/26-041     |     Procurement section / mechanical works
ORIGINAL NOTICE  |  Synthetic data for parser testing only
Page 1
INVITATION FOR SEALED OFFERS
Supply, delivery and commissioning of road-maintenance equipment
Notice circulated on 20 October 2026. The Municipal Works Unit invites offers under procurement reference
ND-MW-2026-041. This notice, the schedule on page 2 and the instructions below are to be read together.
Item / lot
Description and minimum scope
Quantity
Lot 01 / A
Vibratory road compactors, including operating manuals, initial training and
delivery to the municipal depot.
02 units
Lot 01 / B
Consumables and standard service kit for the equipment above. This is included
in the quoted lot price.
01 set
1. RECEIPT AND OPENING OF OFFERS
Completed offers must reach the receiving desk no later than 14:00 hours on 10 November 2026 (Bangladesh local
time, UTC+06:00). The public opening will take place at 14:30 hours on that same date. Documents received after the
closing time will be returned unopened.
2. PARTICIPATION AND EXPERIENCE
Suppliers must hold current trade registration and tax clearance. A bidder shall demonstrate not less than two (2) years
of experience supplying comparable road-maintenance machinery. Joint ventures are permitted, provided the lead
member accepts responsibility for delivery and warranty support.
A manufacturer authorization letter is required. Each bidder shall also hold a valid ISO 9001 certificate at the date of
submission. Copies should be attached in the technical envelope, not included in the price schedule.
See page 2 for security, delivery, financial conditions and the document checklist. The notice publication date is not the deadline
for submitting offers.

4. INTERPRETATION OF SUBSEQUENT NOTICES
Any subsequently issued corrigendum must be read with this invitation. A corrigendum may replace a specific clause
without reproducing the entire notice. Unless expressly changed, the other conditions continue to apply.
Administrative note: questions may be submitted before 03 November 2026. This enquiry date is separate from the offer closing
date. No contact address in this fictional notice represents a real institution.

ADDITIONAL INSTRUCTIONS TO BIDDERS
(a) Insert the following condition after the experience provision: At least one completed comparable supply contract
with a value of BDT 1,000,000 or more must be evidenced by an acceptance certificate. This amount is a qualification
threshold, not a revision to the procurement allocation.
(b) Delete the requirement to hold an ISO 9001 certificate, including its corresponding checklist entry. The requirements
for trade registration, tax clearance and manufacturer authorization are retained.
(c) For avoidance of doubt, the indicative allocation remains BDT 2,500,000. The scope, quantities, payment terms and
joint-venture permission are unchanged. Those clauses are not reproduced in full here.
Read both documents together. Historical dates and figures in the middle column above identify the text being replaced; they are
not alternative current requirements.
